name: mermaid
modifications: None. The self-contained upstream IIFE is bundled verbatim, retaining its license banners. No CDN, online renderer, module imports, or model-provided JavaScript is used.

runtime.android: Android System WebView; minSdk 26. Current WebView is required for the bundled engine's modern JavaScript. Missing/outdated providers produce a Chinese error; no emulator required.
runtime.desktop: OpenJFX 21.0.13 (JDK 17 compatible), host-classified base/graphics/controls/media/web Maven artifacts. An unshown WebView rasterizes sanitized SVG/Mermaid through an app-owned canvas, then releases its document; chat displays a native Compose image, without Swing bridges or auxiliary windows. Linux requires GTK 3 and the native libraries used by JavaFX WebKit. OpenJFX is GPL-2.0 with Classpath exception; WebKit includes LGPL-licensed components. Retain dependency legal notices when redistributing packaged native binaries.
runtime.raster: Native Compose Image: Android BitmapFactory and desktop Skia. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP; animated files show the first frame.
runtime.mermaid: Strict security; HTML labels, URL callbacks, external resources, frontmatter, and initialization/configuration directives are unavailable. 50,000 source characters / 500 edges. Engine timeout 20 seconds and native loading timeout 25 seconds.
runtime.images: HTTP(S) or image data URLs only, 8 MiB encoded payload maximum, dimensions at most 16,384 on either axis and 32 million pixels. Up to five redirects, no HTTPS downgrade or non-HTTP destination. 10-second connect/read timeouts; no arbitrary local file/content/jar access.
runtime.svg: 1 MiB, 10,000 elements, depth 64. XML element allowlist; no DTD/entities, processing instructions, scripts/events, foreignObject, SMIL, external links, images, external CSS/fonts/resources. Internal fragment references are allowed. currentColor and --fg/--foreground/--bg/--background/--surface/--primary/--accent are supplied from Material theme.
